verdict.rationale: E2B's GitHub README points to a first-party Desktop SDK that provides mouse, keyboard, screenshot, application and desktop streaming APIs, so a desktop environment inside the sandbox is offered. That support rests on a single one-line mention with no dedicated docs, and headless-browser support is never stated; custom templates (e2b-docs-17) are only a building block and earn no credit. missing for 10: dedicated documentation of the Desktop SDK and desktop environment, explicit headless browser support (e.g. Chromium/Playwright), hands-on or independent corroboration.
